preconditions.description: The length of string A is at least 1 and at most 10^4.
The length of string B is at least 1 and at most 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A)
preconditions.description: All characters in string A are lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in B)
preconditions.description: All characters in string B are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is -1 if it is not possible to transform A into B, otherwise it is the minimum number of steps required.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 if not all(a in B for a in A) else output == sum(1 for a in A if A.index(a) != B.index(a))
postconditions.description: The output is the number of mismatched characters between A and B, or -1 if A contains a character not in B.
